critique: Nebula cloud structure is right (soft billows, whole-frame, clear morph between t1 and t4) and the palette is violet/purple. Two misses: the grain is far from '少量/subtle' — coarse noise dominates every pixel and competes with the cloud read (Lightness 60 renders much stronger than the intended 6%); and overall luminance is mid-bright in large areas, above background grade for 暗紫色.

suggestions.why: drop lightness-noise amount to a subtle film-grain level
darken the base so the bright billows sit at background luminance
